title: Chapter 299: Great Changes In The Ancient Battlefield
content:
Chapter 299: Great Changes In The Ancient Battlefield

But the only thing that is fortunate is that although the Xuanyuan Sword has no spirit, it is still a very powerful sword.

Didn't you see that even without a spirit, can you still cut a gap into such a terrifying giant sword in front of you?

At the same time, in a vast sea of stars.

A majestic figure seemed to hear the call and slowly looked back.

"Xiaoxue?"

After a moment, Lu Daosheng, who heard something, showed a faint smile.

"How can you know your limit if you don't force yourself?"

"Come on, Dad believes in you."

As he said that, Lu Daosheng waved his hand and an indescribable force suddenly flew out of Lu Daosheng's hand, flew into the sea of stars, and shot towards the direction of the fairy world.

On the side, Yan Lingyun slowly opened her eyes and said a little worriedly: "Why are you like this, aren't you afraid that Xiaoxue will settle the score with you in the future?"

Upon hearing this, Lu Daosheng said seriously: "I am her father, it's all for her own good."

Yan Lingyun rolled her eyes and said nothing.

But what Lu Daosheng said was also right.

If this continues, Lu Xue will not have any growth.

I have to force her.

As for other innocent people, they are never within Lu Daosheng's consideration.

There is only his own people in his heart.

At the same time, Lu Xue, who was in the ancient battlefield, was stunned and Lu Daosheng's words suddenly came to her ears.

Force yourself?

That's how you're forced?

Believe it or not, I will stop playing? ?

Lu Xue was about to say something, but suddenly, a mysterious force suddenly entered the fairy world from the sky.

Then, under the horrified eyes of countless strong men, they rushed straight to the ancient battlefield.

"What is that!"

An old monster who seemed to have existed since ancient times spoke in horror.

The hoarse voice echoed from the fairy world.

But no one responded.

Some are just countless solemn gazes.

What it is, no one knows.

They only know that there seems to be some horror outside the sky.

Buzz —

The mysterious force poured into the ancient battlefield, and in an instant, the entire ancient battlefield began to tremble wildly.

Countless people woke up from their practice.

Some practitioners who were in the two-player game also stopped and looked at the sky in horror.

I saw that the dim sky turned extremely scarlet under the influence of that mysterious force.

The remaining forces around the world left behind by the war that year began to restless.

Unwillingness, anger, and fear continued to flow out from the residual powers.

At this moment, the entire ancient battlefield began to lose control.

boom!

A figure covering the sky and the sun appeared on the ancient battlefield.

He waved his body frantically, causing the space around to shatter.

Immediately afterwards, the second and third terrifying figures continued to emerge.

Looking at the scene in front of him that looked like the end of the world, Lu Xue, Xiao Luo, and Qin Feng were all stunned.

What's going on here! !

"Snow, Sister Xue,"

Xiao Luo's legs were a little weak and his words were trembling.

In response to this, Lu Xue's mouth twitched violently.

At this moment, she understood what her father meant by forcing herself.

You are not a force, you are going to kill me!

Don't play anymore.

If you play again, you will die.

Lu Xue quickly looked up at the void, and her big watery eyes suddenly burst into tears, looking extremely pitiful.

"Dad, I won't play anymore, I won't play anymore, I just want to be by your side now, I miss you so much, wuwu, ,"

"Dad, please let me go back, I will never run around again."

The bitter voice sounded from Lu Xue's little mouth, and Xiao Luo and Qin Feng were both softened by the side.

No wonder there are always people who want to have a daughter.

If you want to have such a daughter, you must not be favored to death.

However, the imagined scene of Lu Daosheng falling from the sky and directly erasing everything like a savior did not appear, and the scene was a little awkward for a while.

"Dad?"

Lu Xue was a little unbelievable.

It's impossible, how could this move be useless?

My dad usually takes this trick the most.

At this time, Lu Daosheng was indeed a little unable to help it, especially when he saw Lu Xue's pitiful look of praying, his heart almost melted.

But Yan Lingyun, on the side, said calmly: "Our daughter has finally got to be independent once. Do you want her to lose all her efforts?"

"Do you want her to live under your protection for the rest of her life?"

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng barely calmed down.

"Lingyun, you are right. If you can't do this, how can you retreat as soon as you encounter difficulties?"

At this time, Lu Xue's voice came again.

"Mom, my dad doesn't care about me anymore, you won't care about me."

"You know, I have never had a mother since I was a child. I finally waited for you, but you left me again."

"I miss you so much, take me away."

Lu Xue's slightly choked voice sounded from Yan Lingyun's ears.

In just a moment, Yan Lingyun's reason disappeared.

"Spiritual rhyme?"

Lu Daosheng looked at Yan Lingyun aside with a daze.

The next moment, Yan Lingyun stood up with a loud voice.

Yan Lingyun's eyes were slightly red, "This is my baby, my biological child."

As he said that, Yan Lingyun was about to set off.

Seeing this scene, Lu Daosheng finally realized his daughter's ability.

It's so scary.

I was just trying to persuade my wife to be rebelled in a blink of an eye.

Lu Daosheng naturally would not sit idly by.

"Spiritual rhyme, etc."

Lu Daosheng grabbed Yan Lingyun's thinness and a sense of tenderness suddenly came.

"Lingyun, you can't spoil her so much, you will have problems."

After hearing this, Yan Lingyun naturally understood.

However, she left Lu Xue since she was a child, leaving Lu Xue without her mother in her childhood.

This made her feel guilty.

Now that Lu Xue talks about it, how could she remain indifferent?

As if she saw what Yan Lingyun was thinking, Lu Daosheng said anxiously: "This is two different things. If you help her now, she will only be able to live in the shadow of two of them for the rest of her life."

"Do you want to watch your daughter be decadent for the rest of your life?"

Hearing this, Yan Lingyun was shaken.

"I,,"

After a long silence, Yan Lingyun shook her head slightly and then returned to Lu Daosheng.

But she never dared to look at Lu Xue again.

She was afraid that she could not help it.

In the ancient battlefield.

Lu Xue can no longer act.

He took a deep breath and clenched his fists slowly, trying to say something harsh, but he didn't dare to speak.

After a moment of silence, Lu Xue suddenly turned her head to look at Xiao Luo and Qin Feng, "You two are still doing something, don't you run away, are you waiting to die?!"

On the side, facing Lu Xue's almost roaring cold shout, Xiao Luo and Qin Feng looked at each other, but they didn't dare to say anything.

This is Sister Xue’s family matter, which is even more terrifying than the crisis in the fairy world.

One cannot handle it well.

Maybe the entire fairy world is gone.

Run away quickly.

At this moment, the giant sword beside him also began to emit a terrifying aura.

It seemed as if I had come alive.
